design_philosophy: A premium, sophisticated, magazine-like editorial presentation for the Intelligent EnterprAIse Summit. The design completely strips away generic SaaS gradients, relying on stark contrast, massive typography, organic grids, and 'Archival Index' structuring to convey authority and high-end exclusivity.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium

button.primary: bg-primary text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors font-subheading text-sm uppercase tracking-widest
button.outline: border border-primary text-primary px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-all font-subheading text-sm uppercase tracking-widest

card.editorial: bg-surface border border-border p-8 md:p-12 shadow-sm rounded-none
card.speaker: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-none

navigation.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/50 py-4
navigation.links: font-subheading text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-text_muted hover:text-text_main transition-colors

sections.name: Hero
sections.style: min-h-[85vh] flex flex-col justify-end pb-24 relative overflow-hidden
sections.content: Massive H1 title overlapping the hero image. Strict layout for date/location in bottom corners.

sections.name: Countdown & About
sections.style: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 py-32 border-t border-border
sections.content: Countdown in massive 'Cabinet Grotesk' on the left (col-span-5). About text in 'Cormorant Garamond' on the right (col-span-7) with generous line height.

sections.name: Lectures & Sessions
sections.content: Two-column staggered layout. Overlapping cards with 1px border. Lots of negative space.

sections.name: Organizers & Sponsors
sections.content: Minimalist logo grid, deeply desaturated/grayscale logos, aligned optically.

sections.name: When & Where
sections.content: Monochrome Google Map styling on one side, stark typographic address details on the other.

sections.name: Header
sections.content: Minimalist header 'The Minds Shaping Enterprise AI'.

sections.name: Speaker Grid
sections.content: Editorial portraits. Grayscale images that reveal color on hover. Bios are placed alongside or below the photo with generous spacing.

sections.name: Timetable
sections.content: Massive typography for hours (e.g., 09:00) on the left, event descriptions on the right. Separated by clean, 1px horizontal lines (`border-b`). No vertical dividers.

hero_bg.description: Abstract gray architecture, perfect for an editorial AI enterprise hero background. Use with a subtle light gradient overlay to ensure text readability.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images should transition from grayscale to full color on hover. Buttons should have a sharp background color fill.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis is mandatory for the premium feel. Elements should fade in with a slight vertical offset (Y-axis 20px) on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Instead of bouncing or scaling, use a subtle 'reveal' or strict color inversion for a high-end feel.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements, forms, and navigation links MUST use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-registration-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No neon or gradients.
Import Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Cabinet Grotesk, and Outfit.
Use CSS Grid or Flexbox to build out the Archival Index aesthetic for the Agenda.
Ensure Cormorant Garamond is applied to H1 and H2 elements.
Ensure generous padding (py-24, px-6 to px-24).
Replace standard browser scrolling with Lenis if possible.
Build separate routes or distinct views for Home, Speakers, and Agenda.
Ensure all images are loaded from the provided media URLs, strictly avoiding placeholders.
All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
